claim: A REAL gradient-guided (HotFlip) AgentPoison-style trigger, optimized on the uniqueness+compactness objective against a differentiable dense retriever, achieves high-confidence retrieval of a single poisoned memory in inspeximus's SEMANTIC channel
source: Chen et al. 2024 (Zhaorun Chen, Zhen Xiang, Chaowei Xiao, Dawn Song, Bo Li), AgentPoison, NeurIPS 2024, arXiv:2407.12784
out_of_scope: coherence loss (approximated by alphabetic-token restriction), target-elicitation loss, downstream agent-action loop, cross-retriever transfer
